stories.headline: Nvidia Invests $500M in Corning Warrants; Corning to Build 3 US Plants and Expand Optical Capacity 10x

key_facts.fact: Nvidia purchased $500M in Corning share rights: warrants to buy up to 15 million shares at $180 each, plus a pre-funded warrant for up to 3 million shares at $0.0001 each.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal gives Nvidia the right to invest up to $3.2 billion in Corning. Nvidia is getting warrants to buy up to 15 million Corning shares at an exercise price of $180 per share... The remaining $500 million comes from a pre-funded warrant for Nvidia to buy up to 3 million shares of Corning.

key_facts.fact: Corning will increase U.S.-based optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and expand domestic fiber production capacity by more than 50%.
key_facts.excerpt: Corning will increase its U.S.-based optical connectivity manufacturing capacity by 10x and expand its U.S. fiber production capacity by more than 50% to meet the accelerating demand driven by AI factory buildouts.

key_facts.fact: Corning will build three new advanced manufacturing facilities in North Carolina and Texas, creating more than 3,000 high-paying American jobs.
key_facts.excerpt: The expansion includes the construction of three new advanced manufacturing facilities in North Carolina and Texas and the creation of more than 3,000 new, high-paying American jobs.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia is likely preparing to replace copper with Corning's optical fibers in its rack-scale AI systems via co-packaged optics, which Jensen Huang called essential at GTC 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia is likely gearing up to replace copper with Corning's optical glass fibers in its AI rack-scale systems, an integration known as co-packaged optics.

key_facts.fact: Corning shares climbed 12-19% on the news; Nvidia stock gained almost 6%. Corning raised its long-term sales target to a $20B annualized run rate by end of 2026, $30B by 2028, and $40B by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: Corning also raised its long-term sales targets on surging demand for AI infrastructure. Its shares rose more than 19% in early trading.

key_facts.fact: The deal extends Nvidia's pattern from March 2026, when it invested $4B across Coherent and Lumentum, the two principal laser-component suppliers for its co-packaged optics platform.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal extends a pattern Nvidia established in March, when the company invested $4bn across Coherent and Lumentum, the two principal laser-component suppliers for its Spectrum-X co-packaged optics platform.

stories.headline: Arm Q4 Revenue Up 20% to Record $1.49B; AGI CPU Demand Doubles to $2B as Datacenter Nears Top Business

key_facts.fact: Arm reported Q4 FY2026 revenue of $1.49B, up 20% YoY, with licensing revenue up 29% to $819M and royalty revenue up 11% to $671M. Non-GAAP EPS was a record $0.60.
key_facts.excerpt: Q4 revenue of $1.49 billion, up 20% YoY... licensing revenue rose 29% to $819 million, while royalty revenue increased 11% to $671 million, helping drive record non-GAAP EPS of $0.60.

key_facts.fact: Full-year FY2026 revenue reached a record $4.92B, up 23% YoY, with non-GAAP EPS of $1.77 for the year.
key_facts.excerpt: For fiscal 2026, Haas said revenue reached a record $4.92 billion, up 23% year-on-year.

key_facts.fact: Customer demand for the Arm AGI CPU, launched in March, has doubled to more than $2B across FY2027 and FY2028, up from $1B stated at launch. Meta is the lead partner.
key_facts.excerpt: The Arm AGI CPU, launched in March, which saw customer demand double to over $2 billion across fiscal 2027-2028... Meta is the lead partner and co-developer, with a multi-generation roadmap to support 'personal super intelligence' for over 3 billion users.

key_facts.fact: Data center royalties more than doubled YoY for the second consecutive year. CEO Rene Haas said datacenter will 'soon' be Arm's largest business.
key_facts.excerpt: He then said Arm is 'on track towards our forecast of $15 billion' annual revenue for AI infrastructure, and added: 'Soon, the datacenter will be Arm's largest business.'

key_facts.fact: Cerebras, OpenAI, Positron, and Rebellions are integrating the Arm AGI CPU alongside accelerator-based systems. Commercial systems are now available from ASRock, Lenovo, Quanta, and Supermicro.
key_facts.excerpt: Cerebras, OpenAI, Positron and Rebellions are integrating the Arm AGI CPU alongside accelerator-based systems... Commercial systems based on the Arm AGI CPU are now available to order from ASRock, Lenovo, Quanta, and Supermicro.

key_facts.fact: Arm warned of phone market weakness, with CEO Haas saying unit growth 'flip to negative' last quarter, concentrated in the lower end.
key_facts.excerpt: CEO Rene Haas said he saw unit growth for phones 'flip to negative' last quarter. But the slowdown is concentrated in the lower end of the market.

key_facts.fact: Q1 FY2027 guidance: revenue of ~$1.26B (up ~20% YoY) and non-GAAP EPS of $0.40. Shares swung widely, dropping ~6% after hours on softer-than-expected guidance.
key_facts.excerpt: Total revenue will be about $1.26 billion in the fiscal first quarter... Arm shares swung widely in late trading, with the stock sliding about 6% by 5:45 p.m. in New York.

stories.headline: Hut 8 Signs $9.8B 15-Year Lease for 352MW AI Data Center in Texas, Total Contracted Value Hits $16.8B

key_facts.fact: Hut 8 signed a 15-year, $9.8B triple-net lease for 352MW of IT capacity at its Beacon Point campus in Nueces County, Texas, with an unnamed high-investment-grade tenant.
key_facts.excerpt: Hut 8 today announced the commercialization of the first phase of its Beacon Point data center campus in Nueces County, Texas through a 15-year, $9.8 billion lease for 352 megawatts of IT capacity.

key_facts.fact: With three 5-year renewal options, the contract value could reach approximately $25.1B. The lease includes a 3.0% annual base rent escalator.
key_facts.excerpt: Three 5-year renewal options increase potential contract value to approximately $25.1 billion assuming all three options are exercised.

key_facts.fact: The facility will be designed to NVIDIA's DSX reference architecture for gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure. Initial data hall delivery is expected in Q3 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Hut 8 to deliver a 352 MW AI factory designed to NVIDIA's DSX reference architecture for gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure.

key_facts.fact: Beacon Point is the second campus under Hut 8's power-first model, following River Bend. Total contracted AI data center capacity is now 597MW with aggregate base-term value of ~$16.8B.
key_facts.excerpt: The Beacon Point announcement adds 352 MW more, bringing total contracted AI data-centre capacity to 597 MW and aggregate base-term value to approximately $16.8bn.

key_facts.fact: Hut 8 has an interconnection agreement for 1,000MW of utility capacity at the site, with initial energization expected in Q1 2027. Roughly half the campus remains available for future deals.
key_facts.excerpt: Genoot said Beacon Point Phase 1 is part of a gigawatt campus with 'roughly half the campus still available for future commercialization.'

key_facts.fact: Hut 8 stock jumped the most since 2021 on the announcement. The company also closed a $3.25B offering of investment-grade senior secured notes for the River Bend project.
key_facts.excerpt: Closed an offering of $3.25 billion of fully amortizing 16.5-year investment-grade senior secured notes to finance the project — the first single-sponsor data center project to access the investment-grade construction bond market.

stories.headline: Samsung Unions Threaten 18-Day Strike Starting May 21 Over AI Chip Profit Sharing

key_facts.fact: Two Samsung Electronics unions are demanding the company pay 15% of each division's operating profits to workers and raise wages by 7%. They threaten an 18-day walkout starting May 21.
key_facts.excerpt: Two Samsung unions are demanding the company pay 15 per cent of each division's operating profits to workers, as well as raise wages by 7 per cent. They have threatened an 18-day walkout starting on May 21.

key_facts.fact: Samsung management offered ~13% of operating profit to chip division staff and special rewards exceeding the OPI upper limit if DS Division achieves top position in domestic sales and profit.
key_facts.excerpt: The management proposed special rewards that would exceed the upper limit of the Outperformance Incentive (OPI) if the DS Division achieved the top position in domestic sales and operating profit.

key_facts.fact: Samsung reported record Q1 2026 results: sales of KRW 133.9T (up 69% YoY) and operating profit of KRW 57.2T (up 756%), surpassing 2025's full-year operating profit in one quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: Samsung Electronics reported sales of KRW 133.9 trillion, a 69% increase compared to the same period last year, and operating profit of KRW 57.2 trillion, a 756% surge. This is the highest quarterly performance ever recorded.

key_facts.fact: Samsung Vice Chairman Jeon Younghyun and President Noh Taemun urged employees not to compromise future competitiveness, warning the global business environment is challenging.
key_facts.excerpt: Vice Chairman Jeon and President Noh stated... 'In this challenging global business environment, all members of management, including ourselves, will take responsibility to ensure that we do not lose our future competitiveness.'

key_facts.fact: Board Chairman Shin Je-yoon warned a strike could cause losses of up to KRW 1T per day at semiconductor plants and reduce operating profit by up to KRW 10T if prolonged.
key_facts.excerpt: If semiconductor plant operations are halted, losses can reach tens of billions of won per minute and up to 1 trillion won per day. If the strike is prolonged, operating profit in the semiconductor division could decrease by as much as 10 trillion won.

key_facts.fact: The Bank of Korea estimates about half of Korea's Q1 GDP growth of 1.7% was attributable to chipmaking. Samsung and SK Hynix account for over 40% of the Kospi index value.
key_facts.excerpt: The Bank of Korea estimates that about half of Korea's first-quarter GDP growth of 1.7% was attributable to chipmaking. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix account for over 40% of the value of the Kospi index.

stories.headline: Microsoft Weighs Delaying or Dropping 2030 Hourly Clean Energy Target Amid Data Center Boom

key_facts.fact: Microsoft is considering delaying or abandoning its 2030 '100/100/0' target of matching 100% of its hourly electricity use with zero-carbon energy purchases on the same grid.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft is weighing whether to delay or scale back one of its most ambitious clean energy goals as its rapid buildout of AI data centers puts pressure on its ability to meet those targets.

key_facts.fact: The hourly matching goal, announced in 2021, is considerably more ambitious than Microsoft's already-met annual matching target. Internal discussions are ongoing with no final decision.
key_facts.excerpt: Announced in 2021, Microsoft's flagship clean-power goal — dubbed 100/100/0 — was meant to match 100 per cent of its electricity consumption, 100 per cent of the time, with zero-carbon energy purchases.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft has already begun reducing its carbon-dioxide removal program. The company's carbon emissions have risen 23% since late 2022.
key_facts.excerpt: In the wake of those costs, Microsoft has already begun reducing its carbon-dioxide removal program... Microsoft has seen a 23 percent jump in carbon emissions since late 2022.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft is spending ~$190B on data centers through end of 2026. Last month, it announced working with Chevron and Engine No. 1 on a natural gas plant in West Texas that could generate up to 5 GW.
key_facts.excerpt: Last month, the company said it was working with Chevron and Engine No. 1 to build a massive natural gas power plant in West Texas that could eventually generate up to 5 gigawatts.

key_facts.fact: A Microsoft spokesperson pointed to recently signed agreements with We Energies to bring 1.2 GW of carbon-free energy projects in Wisconsin onto the grid, starting in December 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: A Microsoft spokesperson said the company continues to look for opportunities to maintain its matching goal, pointing to recently signed agreements with We Energies to bring 1.2 gigawatts of carbon-free energy projects in Wisconsin onto the grid.

stories.headline: MEMS Foundry Silex Surges 127% in Stockholm IPO Debut, Strongest European Chip Listing in Five Years

key_facts.fact: Silex Microsystems debuted on Nasdaq Stockholm on May 7, with shares surging up to 127% above the IPO price of SEK 81 per share. The offering was oversubscribed several times.
key_facts.excerpt: Silex Microsystems opened sharply higher on its Nasdaq Stockholm debut on Wednesday, with the chipmaker's shares climbing in early trade after the IPO priced at SEK 81 a share. The offering had been oversubscribed several times.

key_facts.fact: The IPO raised approximately SEK 2.0B (~$220M) on a 24.6 million share offering, with a post-IPO valuation of SEK 8.9B. Proceeds split between 12.35M newly issued shares and 12.25M existing shares.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal raised approximately SEK 1.99bn ($217m) on a 24.6-million-share offering, with the equity valuation at IPO around SEK 8.9bn.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg called it the strongest open for a sizable European IPO in almost five years. Cornerstone investors including Capital Research, Fidelity, and Swedish pension funds took ~75% of shares.
key_facts.excerpt: The debut marked the strongest open for a sizable European IPO in almost five years, after cornerstone investors took the majority of the shares in the offering.

key_facts.fact: Silex is the world's leading pure-play MEMS foundry, manufacturing micro-electromechanical systems for automotive, industrial, life sciences, and consumer electronics from a single fab near Stockholm.
key_facts.excerpt: Silex is the world's leading MEMS foundry as measured by annual revenue generated from MEMS sales in 2025. Silex operates as a pure play MEMS foundry.

key_facts.fact: Silex reported 2025 revenue of SEK 1.385B with EBIT of SEK 368M (~27% operating margin). Q1 2026 was stronger: SEK 375M revenue and SEK 128M EBIT (~34% operating margin).
key_facts.excerpt: Net sales for the year ended 31 December 2025 reached SEK 1,385m, with EBIT of SEK 368m, an operating margin around 27 per cent. First-quarter 2026 numbers were stronger still, with SEK 375m of revenue and SEK 128m of EBIT.

key_facts.fact: Silex's Chinese shareholder Sai MicroElectronics sold existing shares as part of the offering. The IPO welcomed 14,000 new shareholders.
key_facts.excerpt: Silex Microsystems AB surged in its first day of trading on Nasdaq Stockholm after an initial public offering that raised about 2 billion Swedish kronor ($220 million) for the specialist microchip-maker and its Chinese shareholder Sai MicroElectronics Inc.

stories.headline: Anthropic Signs Deal for All of SpaceX's Colossus 1: 220,000+ NVIDIA GPUs and 300MW of Capacity

key_facts.fact: Anthropic signed a deal to use all compute capacity at SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center in Memphis, gaining access to 220,000+ NVIDIA GPUs (H100, H200, GB200) and 300MW of new capacity within the month.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic on Wednesday announced a deal with Elon Musk's SpaceX to use all of the compute capacity at his company's Colossus 1 data center in Memphis, Tennessee... more than 300 megawatts of compute capacity.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic also expressed interest in partnering with SpaceX to develop multiple gigawatts of orbital AI compute capacity, citing terrestrial power, land, and cooling constraints.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic also 'expressed interest' in working with SpaceX to develop multiple gigawatts of compute capacity in space.

key_facts.fact: Musk reversed his stance on Anthropic, saying he spent time with their team and was 'impressed.' In February he had called Anthropic 'misanthropic' and said Claude 'hates Western Civilization.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'Everyone I met was highly competent and cared a great deal about doing the right thing. No one set off my evil detector,' Musk wrote. 'Anthropic hates Western Civilization,' Musk wrote in February.

key_facts.fact: Musk confirmed xAI 'will be dissolved as a separate company' and will be called SpaceXAI. SpaceX has moved its AI training to Colossus 2.
key_facts.excerpt: In a separate post on X on Wednesday, Musk said that xAI 'will be dissolved as a separate company' and will be called SpaceXAI.

key_facts.fact: The deal adds to Anthropic's growing stack of compute agreements: up to 5GW with Amazon, 5GW with Google/Broadcom, $30B Azure capacity with Microsoft/Nvidia, and $50B US AI infra with Fluidstack.
key_facts.excerpt: An up to 5 gigawatt agreement with Amazon that includes nearly 1 gigawatt of new capacity by year-end, a 5 gigawatt deal with Google and Broadcom that comes online in 2027, a Microsoft-NVIDIA strategic partnership covering $30 billion of Azure capacity, and a $50 billion U.S. AI infrastructure investment with Fluidstack.

key_facts.fact: Reports have highlighted that xAI was only utilizing ~11% of its installed compute resources due to unoptimized software stacks, freeing capacity for the Anthropic lease.
key_facts.excerpt: Recently, reports have highlighted that xAI is only utilizing just 11% of its installed AI compute resources due to unoptimized software stacks.

key_facts.fact: The deal arrives weeks before SpaceX's planned IPO targeting a $1.75T-$2T valuation, with the public S-1 expected by late May and roadshow set for the week of June 8.
key_facts.excerpt: SpaceX filed confidentially with the SEC on April 1 for an IPO targeting a $1.75 trillion to $2 trillion valuation, with the public S-1 expected by late May and the roadshow set for the week of June 8.
